newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish August reserve money data postponed to Wed.
newsitem.headline: Polish August reserve money data postponed to Wed.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland's (NBP) open market committee (KKOOR) statement on August's average reserve money level will be delayed until Wednesday, a NBP official said.
The data were originally planned for Tuesday.
The central bank official said the KKOOR bi-weekly meeting, earlier scheduled for Monday, was postponed to Tuesday.
Reserve money, the central bank's operational target through which it controls the growth of money supply and inflation, comprises cash in circulation, cash in vaults and banks' obligatory reserves.
The central bank earlier set the daily average reserve money target for August between 31.93 and 32.63 billion zlotys.
